theorem real_sequence_tendsto_iff_eventually_pairwise_close
    (xSeq : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto xSeq Filter.atTop (nhds x) ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∀ n m : ℕ, N < n → N < m → |xSeq n - xSeq m| < ε := by

  · intro h ε hε

    have h_eventually := h (ε/2) hhalf
    rcases Filter.eventually_atTop.mp h_eventually with ⟨N, hN⟩
    use N+1
    constructor
    · omega
    · intro n m hn hm
      have hn' : N ≤ n := by omega
      have hm' : N ≤ m := by omega
      have hdist_n : dist (xSeq n) x < ε/2 := hN n hn'
      have hdist_m : dist (xSeq m) x < ε/2 := hN m hm'
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist_n hdist_m
      have h_abs_sub : |x - xSeq m| = |xSeq m - x| := abs_sub x (xSeq m)
      calc
        |xSeq n - xSeq m| = |(xSeq n - x) + (x - xSeq m)| := by ring
        _ ≤ |xSeq n - x| + |x - xSeq m| := abs_add _ _
        _ = |xSeq n - x| + |xSeq m - x| := by rw [h_abs_sub]
        _ < ε/2 + ε/2 := by linarith
        _ = ε := by ring

import Mathlib

theorem real_sequence_tendsto_iff_eventually_pairwise_close
    (xSeq : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto xSeq Filter.atTop (nhds x) ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∀ n m : ℕ, N < n → N < m → |xSeq n - xSeq m| < ε := by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    have hhalf : ε/2 > 0 := by linarith
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at h
    rcases h (ε/2) hhalf with ⟨N, hN⟩
    use N+1
    constructor
    · omega
    · intro n m hn hm
      have hn' : N ≤ n := by omega
      have hm' : N ≤ m := by omega
      have hdist_n : dist (xSeq n) x < ε/2 := hN n hn'
      have hdist_m : dist (xSeq m) x < ε/2 := hN m hm'
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist_n hdist_m
      have h_eq : (xSeq n - x) + (x - xSeq m) = xSeq n - xSeq m := by ring

        _ ≤ |xSeq n - x| + |x - xSeq m| := abs_add _ _
        _ = |xSeq n - x| + |xSeq m - x| := by rw [abs_sub_comm]
        _ < ε/2 + ε/2 := by linarith
